- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.5) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast peak by 5–10%.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.5), model underestimates; adjust downward by 3–7% to align with mean reversion.
- Model often overshoots after sharp price spikes; apply a 1–2 day lag correction by reducing forecast by 2–5% on next day.
- Forecast mean tends to be 2–3% higher than true outcome in 30-day horizon; apply a 2–3% downward bias adjustment.
- If sentiment shows strong reversal (e.g., from +1.23 to -0.99), model fails to correct; reduce forecast by 5–10% in next 5–7 days.
- In high volatility periods (e.g., 2025-01-23), model overreacts to short-term sentiment; cap forecast at 10% above recent 7-day average.
